title: Foundations
mandate: Basic facts about cards, decks and hypomorphism; the simplest recognizable invariants (order, edge count).

title: Kelly's lemma and recognizable invariants
mandate: Formalize Kelly's lemma (subgraph counts from the deck) and derive degree sequence, connectivity and other recognizable properties.

title: Regular graphs
mandate: Prove that regular graphs are reconstructible.

title: Disconnected graphs
mandate: Prove that disconnected graphs are reconstructible (Kelly 1957 / Harary 1974).
